pkgmetadata.longdescription: BinPm is a package manager for binaries. It resolves a package to a version, downloads the release asset that matches the running OS and CPU, verifies its SHA-256 checksum, extracts it and puts the resulting commands on PATH. Packages come from GitHub releases or from a static HTTP registry.

use.flag: Build and run the test suite. Needs network access to restore the xunit packages from NuGet.
